prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI post-auth study resumption dashboard concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for current-account-redirect dashboard state, not a consent UI.
Primary request: Redesign 40-X-18-auth-consent/current-account-redirect.
Direction: post-auth study resumption.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Show an authenticated dashboard first viewport for an existing account after consent check: left navigation, today's learning, next writing task, progress summary, recent feedback, quiet notification area, quick start links. Explicitly avoid any consent form, consent checklist, OAuth/provider panel, or raw auth status.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Dashboard/Card/List/Button UI, compact study workspace, 4-8px panel radii.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5, Snow #ffffff, Fog #ececee, Ink/Steel text, Obsidian #09090b only for primary study CTA.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, weight-driven hierarchy, compact density, no letter spacing.
Constraints: state signal is successful redirect to dashboard and study continuation; one next study action should dominate; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, consent form, legal checklist, OAuth details, tokens, raw errors, AI gradients, colorful CTAs, oversized workspace bubbles, watermark.
